SELECT t.loss_type AS lossType, IFNULL(SUM(t.loss_qty), 0) AS lossQty, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM food_wip_transfer t WHERE t.work_order_id = #{workOrderId} AND t.del_flag = '0' AND t.loss_type IS NOT NULL AND t.loss_type != '' GROUP BY t.loss_type
